svg.text: A100 · token DiT block (AF3 Alg. 23) · training · d 768, cond 384, pair 128, 16 heads × 48, transition n = 2, bf16, A even
forward (saves x, ĉ, G, Gg, xa, qkvg, o, lse, og, y, x1, xt, ab, z, p̂, bias)
ĉ = LN(cond), c = bf16(cond) # statistics saved
G = ĉ @ Wnᵀ # s1 | sh1 | s2 | sh2, cond-LN weights folded into Wn
x = single (fp32); xa = LN(x) · sigmoid(G[:, :768] + bs1) + G[:, 768:1536]
bias = (Wf @ p̂ᵀ).view(16, L, L) # natural units; masked keys = -inf
s = sm_scale q kᵀ + bias; o = softmax(s) v # fp32 o
lse = log2 Σ exp2(s · log2 e) # per sample, head, query
F5 · gate, output projection, residual, AdaLN
og = sigmoid(g) · o; y = og @ Woᵀ
ab = xt @ [Wa; Wb]ᵀ; h = silu(a) · b; z = h @ Wsᵀ
backward; dqkvg = [dq | dk | dv | dg], one buffer; the attention kernels read the saved bias, lse and the row term D
dz = dout; dGg[:, 768:] and the bg2 sum from z
dh = dz @ Ws; dWs = dzᵀ @ h
dab = swiglu'(ab) · dh (h recomputed for dWs)
dxt = dab @ [Wa; Wb]; d[Wa; Wb] = dabᵀ @ xt
dy = dx1 · sigmoid(gate1); dG, dGg, bs2 / bg1 sums
dog = dy @ Wo; dWo = dyᵀ @ og
dO = dog · sigmoid(g); D = Σ_d dO o; dg = dog · o · sigmoid'(g)
P = exp2(scl q kᵀ + bias log2 e − lse); dS = P (dO vᵀ − D)
dq = sm_scale dS k; db[h, i, j] = Σ_a dS # 4 samples per CTA, then a fixed-order reduce
Pᵀ = exp2(scl k qᵀ + biasᵀ log2 e − lse); dSᵀ = Pᵀ (v dOᵀ − D)
dv = Pᵀ dO; dk = sm_scale dSᵀ q
B7 · q | k | v gradient, projection backward, AdaLN backward
dqkvg[:, :2304] = bf16(dq | dk | dv); bq sum
dxa = dqkvg @ Wqkvg; dWqkvg = dqkvgᵀ @ xa
dx = dx1 + LN backward(dxa · sigmoid'); dG
dĉ = dG @ Wn; dWn = dGᵀ @ ĉ; dcond, dW1 / dW2, d(LN_cond weight)
dWf = db @ p̂; dp̂ = dbᵀ @ Wf; dpair = LN backward(dp̂)
dout, dsingle, dx1, dy, dog, dO
